name: outl
description: Local-first outliner with P2P sync. Serves the outl UI in a Home Assistant panel, exposes the MCP server, and shares the workspace volume with the rest of Home Assistant.

pairing_ticket.description: Ticket: eyJ... from `outl peer pair` on a machine with existing notes. Join runs at boot; clear it after pairing.

peer_name.description: Name this device advertises to peers (default: hostname).
